name: Chiptune stage
doc: A chiptune gig on a low-res grid: a wall of LED equalizer blocks (16 bands, green to red), a truss of lamps chasing the beat, sweeping spotlights and speaker stacks whose woofers pump on the bass, a disco floor whose tiles light on the beat, and a line of code-drawn pixel dancers stepping a frame per beat and jumping on the bass. `kick` (bind to an onset envelope) flashes the lamps and the floor.

pixels.doc: grid height in pixels; match the pixel-art effect

dancers.doc: how many dancers (the middle one is the lead, larger)

kick.doc: flash on kicks; bind to an onset envelope

hue.doc: shifts the light colours around the wheel
